You can learn more about CyboPal ONE on Kickstarter. The price through my link is $1499. The regular KS price is $1599, and my link offers a special discounted rate.

What if your computer didn’t just sit on your desk - but actually moved with you?

In this video, I’m taking a closer look at CyboPal ONE, a robotic 27-inch 4K display with a six-degree-of-freedom robotic body designed to physically reposition the display around you.

From Track Once and gesture control to voice interaction with applications, windows, browser pages, media and text input, CyboPal ONE explores a very different way of interacting with a desktop setup.

I’ll also test features like Screen Rotate, Hands-On Adjust, Speak to Type, Focus Mode, Return Home, Safety Stop, Quick Reset and Privacy Mode.
